notes: Use the grade listed in the owner handbook. Shorten to 5000 km in heavy city traffic or dusty conditions.
Inspect every service. Replace early if driven on dusty or unpaved roads.
Replace more often in polluted cities. A musty smell from the vents is the usual sign.
In-tank filters on many models are replaced with the pump assembly.
Drain water from the separator at every service.
Check gap at every second service.
Do not clean iridium plugs with abrasives.
Brake fluid absorbs moisture over time regardless of distance driven. Replace on time even if the car is barely used.
Inspect at every service. Replace when friction material is below 3 mm.
Inspect at every service. Rear pads usually last longer than front.
Measure thickness against the minimum stamped on the disc.
Use only the coolant type specified. Mixing types causes gelling.
Some sealed units are lifetime fill. Check the handbook before draining.
Check for metal particles on the drain plug magnet.
Replace the tensioner and water pump at the same time. A snapped belt on an interference engine destroys the engine.
No fixed interval. Investigate rattle on cold start as a possible stretched chain.
Look for cracks glazing and fraying at every service.
Test capacity at every service after three years. Indian summer heat shortens battery life.
Rotate front to rear to even out wear.
Also needed after hitting a large pothole or kerb.
Vibration in the steering at highway speed is the usual sign.
Check refrigerant charge and cabin filter together.
Replace when they streak or chatter.
Check bushes shock absorbers and ball joints for play.
Check for leaks rust and loose mountings.
Check pedal free play and for slipping under load.
Applies to rear wheel drive and four wheel drive vehicles.
Not applicable to electric power steering systems.
